decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established, popular biodynamic range at the core of the firm's organic yogurt competence, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
The mild sliced cheese is a low-risk extension of the firm's in-house cheesemaking, has its own product page, and serves steady organic retail demand for convenient sliced formats.
Sliced butter cheese is a mainstream variety that fits the firm's existing cheese production and organic positioning, so keeping it for at least another year is the likely course.
